customPrompt:
⚠ CRITICAL RULE — READ FIRST BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE:
This is a TWO-PERSON GROUP PHOTO task. The final image MUST contain EXACTLY TWO distinct people with TWO COMPLETELY DIFFERENT FACES.
DO NOT face-swap. DO NOT replace the footballer's face. DO NOT apply Image 2's face onto the person in Image 1.
The footballer in Image 1 is PERSON A — he stays 100% unchanged, pixel-perfect, face and all.
The person in Image 2 is PERSON B — a brand-new second individual ADDED to the scene standing next to PERSON A.
If the output shows only one person, or shows PERSON A's body with PERSON B's face, the task has FAILED.

Image 1: Base scene — a professional football stadium celebration photograph taken at near eye-level to slightly low, telephoto compression, portrait 4:5 framing. Evening or night match atmosphere under stadium floodlights. PERSON A: a male footballer with dark skin and very short bleached-blond hair, photographed from roughly upper thighs/waist upward. Right arm raised high above the head, elbow bent, hand pointing downward with an extended finger, black glove or mask-like item held in the raised hand. Left arm relaxed downward and mostly out of the lower frame. Small confident smile, mouth slightly open with teeth partially visible, eyes alert and directed near the camera/viewer area. Kit: split orange/yellow and deep red/maroon short-sleeve Galatasaray-style match jersey — viewer-left side mostly orange/yellow, viewer-right side mostly red/maroon, dark maroon/black collar and sleeve cuff trim, Puma logo on chest in gold/white, Galatasaray G/S crest with stars on upper chest, round red Turkish flag badge with white crescent/star on upper chest, large "SOCAR" sponsor text across the front. White match shorts partially visible at bottom-right edge of frame. Subject is positioned center-right in the frame; large soft dark negative space fills the upper-left and left side, emphasizing the raised arm gesture. Background: heavily blurred stadium crowd — dark gray/black with warm orange/red patches, small band of green pitch visible along the bottom edge.

Image 2: Identity reference for PERSON B only — extract the face, body proportions, and physical appearance of this person. They will be added as a SECOND person standing next to PERSON A.

Instruction:
Place PERSON B standing in the left side of the frame, in the negative space currently occupied by the dark background — beside PERSON A, on his left side (viewer's right toward center-left), as if both are sharing the same celebration moment on the pitch.

PERSON A — ZERO MODIFICATIONS:
- His face, dark skin tone, short bleached-blond hair, confident smile, alert eyes: unchanged
- Right arm raised high with black glove/mask item in hand, left arm position: unchanged
- His center-right positioning in the frame: unchanged
- Split orange/yellow and red/maroon jersey, SOCAR sponsor, Puma logo, all branding: unchanged
- White match shorts at bottom edge: unchanged
- Dark upper-left negative space — do not fill entirely; maintain the dramatic asymmetric composition
- Heavily blurred dark gray/black-purple stadium crowd background: unchanged
- Small green pitch band at the bottom edge: unchanged
- Do not alter a single pixel of his appearance or the scene

PERSON B — FACE (the single most critical requirement — zero tolerance for deviation):
⚠ Image 2 contains a PHOTOGRAPH of a real person's face. You must COPY this photograph directly — do NOT generate a new face, do NOT render a generic or averaged face, do NOT use Image 2 merely as a loose reference. Treat it as a face transplant: the exact face from the photograph must appear on PERSON B's body with no alterations whatsoever.
- Face shape, skull structure, forehead height, jawline, chin: exact copy from Image 2 — not similar, IDENTICAL
- Eyes: exact shape, color, spacing, eyelid fold, brow thickness and arch — copied from Image 2 pixel-accurately
- Nose: exact shape, width, bridge height, nostril shape — copied from Image 2
- Mouth and lips: exact shape, thickness, and proportions — copied from Image 2
- Skin tone and texture: exact match including any blemishes, marks, or asymmetries — do not smooth, lighten, darken, or idealize even slightly
- Hair: exact style, color, density, part, and hairline — copied from Image 2
- Beard/stubble: exact coverage, density, color, and growth pattern — copied from Image 2 if present
- Facial asymmetry: preserve any natural asymmetry — do not correct or balance the face
- Age markers: preserve all visible age lines, wrinkles, or features — do not rejuvenate
- DO NOT generate a new face. DO NOT average the face. DO NOT idealize. DO NOT beautify.
- If Image 2's face is not reproduced with full photographic accuracy, the task has FAILED.
- A viewer who knows the person in Image 2 must be able to identify them instantly in the output

PERSON B — KIT (exact copy of PERSON A's match jersey, no improvisation):
- Top: identical split orange/yellow and deep red/maroon short-sleeve match jersey — viewer-left panel orange/yellow, viewer-right panel red/maroon, same color split proportions as PERSON A's jersey

- Puma logo: same gold/white Puma logo on same chest position as PERSON A
- Galatasaray G/S crest: copy EXACTLY from PERSON A's jersey — with EXACTLY 5 STARS above it. Not 3 stars. Not 4 stars. Exactly 5 stars — the same count as visible on PERSON A's jersey in Image 1. The crest shape must be accurate and legible — do not distort, blur, or invent the badge. The 5 stars must be clearly visible, evenly spaced, and correctly rendered.
- Turkish flag badge: same round red badge with white crescent and star on the same upper-chest position as PERSON A
- "SOCAR" sponsor text: same large white capital letters, same font weight, same center-front position as PERSON A

PERSON B — Pose and gaze:
- PERSON B must NOT look directly into the camera
- Body and gaze naturally motivated by the scene: triumphant stadium celebration moment at night, high energy, crowd reacting, broadcast atmosphere

- PERSON A remains center-right; PERSON B occupies the left portion of the frame
- Maintain the dramatic asymmetric composition — the large dark negative space is an intentional design element, not empty space to be filled entirely

- Scale: both appear roughly the same height and distance from camera, on the same ground plane

- Color grading: dramatic premium sports editorial — warm orange/maroon kit against cool dark stadium tones, high contrast

Lighting for PERSON B:
- Stadium floodlight, front and slightly above, moderately hard highlights on face/forehead/cheekbones
- Soft-to-moderate shadows under chin and in jersey folds
- Cool-neutral color temperature balanced against warm orange/red jersey colors, high subject contrast against dark background
- Cast shadows and highlights consistent with the same lighting source as PERSON A

Final quality constraints:
- The result must look like both people were photographed together in the same single frame during the same celebration — not composited
- No watermarks. No FOTOTARENA text. No %100 overlay graphic. No floating artifacts. No seam lines between the two people
- Both subjects must appear to be standing on the same physical green pitch ground plane
- No distorted faces, hands, logos, or badge graphics
- Photorealistic sports editorial quality, night stadium atmosphere
